result.content: Rene Magritte, Belgian artist, a prominent Surrealist painter, whose bizarre flights of fancy blended horror, peril, comedy, and mystery. His best-known paintings included The Treachery of Images and Time Transfixed. His works were characterized by particular symbols—the bowler hat, apple, and other ordinary objects.

result.title: Rene Magritte Biography
result.content: Rene Magritte Biography Rene Magritte was born in Lessines, in the province of Hainaut, in 1898, the eldest son of Leopold Magritte, who was a tailor and textile merchant, and Regina (nee Bertinchamps), a milliner until her marriage. Little is known about Magritte's early life. He began lessons in drawing in 1910.
